title: Audit telemetry degradation RCA and SLO realignment for RBACv2/SAML admin paths
creator: Aisha Patel
description: After the 2026-02 runtime batching changes we observed loss and delayed delivery of audit events for admin SSO/SAML flows and RBACv2 principal changes. This ticket consolidates the RCA, immediate mitigations, SLO adjustments, and long-term fixes to prevent recurrence.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause documented and validated in RCA notes
Hotfix deployed that guarantees audit event delivery for admin flows within acceptable latency
SLOs updated and alerts tuned with runbook changes
End-to-end integration test for SAML/RBAC admin audit path added to CI
notes: Initial detection: spike in 'audit_exporter_dropped' metric and increase in admin config drift alerts on 2026-02-24 03:12 UTC
Observation: high batching thresholds in serving runtime introduced head-of-line blocking for low-throughput admin paths
KV-changefeed consumer backlog exposed a race in the audit queue acknowledgment path leading to silent drops when exporter retried
We saw correlated increase in GC pauses on exporter pod autoscaled instances during the window
timeline: 2026-02-24 03:18 - TOC assembled: Security, Serving, Observability, SRE
2026-02-24 04:05 - Rolling restart of audit-exporter to temporarily clear backlog
2026-02-24 05:00 - Hotfix deployed: reduce max batch window for admin-tagged events and enable immediate flush
2026-03-01 - Full RCA completed; fix in review
2026-03-08 - Canary rollout of consumer-ack-fix on staging
2026-03-10 - Integration tests added and SLO proposal approved by Security and SRE
root_cause_summary: Combination of increased batching/windowing optimizations in the serving runtime and an unhandled error path in the audit queue consumer's ack logic caused intermittent drops of low-throughput admin audit events (SSO/SAML assertions and RBAC principal updates). The exporter scaling policy and GC-induced stalls amplified the effect during peak maintenance windows.
mitigations: Hotfix: Immediately flush admin-tagged audit batches and add per-tenant max-latency cap (deployed 2026-02-24)
Rollback option documented and tested in deploy playbook
Temporarily increase exporter replicas and set CPU request floor to reduce GC pauses
long_term_actions: Fix audit queue ack race and add idempotent persistence for audit events (ENG-62990)
Introduce per-path sampling and dedicated low-latency pipeline for admin/SAML/RBAC events (ENG-63112)
Add e2e CI test simulating SAML login+RBAC change to assert audit event presence within 2s
Revise SLOs: delivery latency P99 <= 2s for admin flows; availability 99.99% daily
Add more granular telemetry: event-shaped metrics, dropped_event_reason tag
alerts_changes: Audit exporter dropped events rate > 0.5/min triggers immediate paging
Add dashboard panel for admin-path delivery trace with correlation IDs
runbook_updates: Updated 'audit-exporter' runbook with steps to force-flush admin pipeline and scale replicas
New playbook section: 'SAML admin audit missing' with triage checklist and quick rollback commands
tests_and_metrics: Added integration test 'saml_admin_audit_integration' to ci-auth (passes in staging)
Synthetic canary injecting admin SAML event every 30s into prod to validate delivery
stakeholder_communications: Draft sent to Security and Legal on 2026-02-26 summarizing exposure for customers with admin audit requirements
Customer outreach template prepared for impacted enterprise accounts; pending CSM approval
